thought: To distinguish the Political Instructor (ID 7) from the combat-focused squad members (IDs 1-5) and the higher-ranking Regiment Commander (ID 8), I need to focus on his role as an ideological leader and officer. While the soldiers carry rifles and the high commander implies heavy strategic burden, the Instructor should bridge the gap between intellect and action. His distinctive feature will be a specific combination of equipment that signifies 'officer on the ground': a Mauser C96 (Box Cannon) pistol and, crucially, a leather document case strapped across his chest. This separates him from the rifle-bearing soldiers and gives him a different silhouette than the older Regiment Commander. His age will be late 20s—younger than the senior commanders but more mature and educated in appearance than the teenage soldiers.
distinctive_features: Late 20s. Wears a brown leather document case across the chest and carries a Mauser C96 pistol in a wooden holster. Clean-shaven, chiseled intellectual face.
